1. Basis of the Offer
With reference to the discussions and addition of static pile tests, we are pleased to submit our revised offer
(Value Engineering Proposal) for the piling works.
If the Main Contractor supply the concrete (45 N/mm²) and steel, the corresponding amounts shall be
deducted as per the actual consumption at site from Simplex’s progressive billing at the rate of BD
31.500/m³(Without ICE) for concrete and BD 345.000/ton for steel.
The approximate quantity considered for Concrete is 1125 m3 and for steel (fabricated pile cages) is 66
ton, including test piles.
Any additional tests required by the client/consultant requirement, other than mentioned in our BOQ
shall be charged additionally, on pro rate basis.
In the event of any discrepancy between the soil investigation report and the actual soil conditions
encountered during drilling, the pile lengths shall be re-evaluated and revised accordingly. Any
increase in pile length arising from such discrepancies shall be charged on a pro-rate basis.
Since the boreholes were terminated at a depth of 13.0 m, we have assumed that the same soil parameters
will continue beyond this depth and have adopted these values for the design up to the required pile depth.
As this is our Value Engineering Proposal, any variations arising during the final design or due to Consultant
comments, which are not included in our BOQ, shall be charged on a pro-rate basis.
The quantities and pile layout have been prepared based on the architectural drawings provided and the
discussions held, and shall be approved by the Consultant prior to execution.
The supply, installation, shifting, removal, and installation of the MS plates shall be under the scope and
responsibility of the Main Contractor. The underground services that are required to be re-routed at the site
shall be protected using 25 mm thick MS plates, covering a maximum length of 40 running meters at any one
time. Upon completion of the works in the respective area, the MS plates shall be removed and relocated to
the subsequent work area as required, allowing the same plates to be reused progressively along the required
route. Proper access for our heavy machinery to reach the required site locations, including any demolition
works required for access, shall be arranged by the Main Contractor. The site shall be properly levelled and
uniformly compacted prior to the mobilization of our machinery. Removal of any underground structures, re-
routing of underground services, and relocation or protection of overhead services, providing light
arrangement for late night work shall be under the scope of the Main Contractor. Obtaining all necessary
permissions for carrying out work during late-night hours shall be the responsibility of the Main Contractor.
During pile execution works, vibrations may occur as a result of the piling operations. The Main Contractor
shall take the necessary measures to prevent any significant damage to existing structures within or in the
immediate vicinity of the site. For tender clarifications please contact Mr. Mohammed (33523334).

3.01 General The quantities are based on the column reactions & comments provided by the PostTension & Pile Cap Designer on 11-10-2026 and soil investigation report ,if any extra
quantities arising during the final design or site execution stage, which will be charged on
pro rate basis.
Eccentric piles are designed in such a way that the moment arising due to the eccentricity
is partially (50%) govern by the pile cap and tie beam and partially (50%) by the pile.
No reduction in group efficiency considered assuming enough spacing can be provided
between piles.
We have designed the pile lengths based on our review of the available soil investigation
reports. If any discrepancy is observed between the actual soil conditions encountered at
site and the soil borehole logs, the pile lengths shall be rechecked and reviewed before
proceeding with further piling works.
The pile is designed as a column and the minimum percentage of reinforcement
considered is 0.4% (BS 8110-1-1997, table 3.25)
Lateral load considered is 5% of the safe working load.
If any type of extra pile test carried out as per consultant’s requirement, which is not
mentioned in our BOQ, additional will be charged as per the actuals.
Any other type of insurance required as per the project specific other than
mentioned in our BOQ shall be charged additionally as per the actuals.
We have considered installation of temporary casing by Vibro hammer or rotary as per
site requirement.
